english: This brings us to our second point from above: advice that we rely on an understanding of the profound. We'll cover this in two points-helping the reader recall the way in which the extreme view that nothing exists at all has already been refuted; and then advice that we should listen now to how the extreme view that everything exists as it seems is in its turn refuted. Recalling how Lord Buddha has already refuted the idea that nothing exists
